record.one_liner: Gladly is a customer service platform (agent desk, chat, customer profiles) with a REST API for customer data and timelines.
record.auth_notes: Basic Auth where the username is the agent's Gladly email and the password is an API token generated in the Gladly UI. Per the rubric, a token sent as the Basic-auth password is api_key.
record.access_notes: API tokens require an existing Gladly organization account in which an admin grants the API User permission to a user. No free developer signup, sandbox-only signup or public pricing for API access was found in the pages fetched. Treated as contact_sales by inference, so confidence is medium.
record.api_notes: Docs describe customer profile data, customer timeline interaction and order information, plus a separate Lookup API that the vendor calls. Full object coverage was not verified.
record.blocker_notes: A developer needs a Gladly customer org with an admin-granted API User permission before any API token exists. The official MCP is Gladly-hosted for Gladly org users, needs an eligible Gladly role, and is not a self-serve developer path. A community MCP also exists (Cotlet on Glama).

evidence.quote: Gladly API uses token-based Basic Authentication. API tokens are associated with designated Gladly users.
